name: paybridge-ai
description: CorridorFlow: Autonomous Agentic Commerce & Cross-Border Treasury Protocol with PayPal Sandbox & AG Grid

scripts.setup: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.apimatic:serve: npm run apimatic:sync && apimatic portal serve --input=./apimatic --open
scripts.apimatic:generate: npm run apimatic:sync && apimatic portal generate --input=./apimatic
scripts.apimatic:sdk:typescript: npm run apimatic:sync && apimatic sdk generate --language=typescript --input=./apimatic --destination=./apimatic/generated-sdk/typescript
